history.content: Okay everyone, a quick bonus puzzle before we wrap up. The sentence I’m about to read is an anagram of one of the Bard’s most famous lines from Hamlet’s soliloquy. Decode the original line and give it to me without punctuation. The anagram is: Our stalwart hero Hamlet, earnest in thought, queries in the mind whether to endure the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune or not to be that is the question.

history.name: String_Algorithms_Expert
history.content:
I will extract the anagram text from the transcription and verify if it’s a perfect anagram of the canonical Hamlet line.

```python
import re
from collections import Counter

anagram_text = (
    "Our stalwart hero Hamlet, earnest in thought, queries in the mind "
    "whether to endure the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune or not to be "
    "that is the question."
)

candidate_line = (
    "To be or not to be that is the question whether tis nobler in the mind "
    "to suffer the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune"
)

def normalize(s):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z]', '', s.lower())

is_anagram = Counter(normalize(anagram_text)) == Counter(normalize(candidate_line))
print("Is perfect anagram:", is_anagram)
```
